snippet.title: WDL Thunder Tanks Gameplay PS2 Playstation  (www.chilloutgames.co.uk)
snippet.description:
http://www.chilloutgames.co.uk/
100% Gameplay 0% gossip

Geo, Hamster and chiii0ut go head-to-head in a fast paced tank battle. Not bad for cheap thrills (if you can turn off the commentators).

Get it here for PS2:
http://www.chilloutgames.co.uk/acatalog/PS2_Battle__War.html
and here for PS1:
